1.consolidated_definition: Inscripción, matrícula. Certificado o acto de incluir una persona, vehículo, marca, etc. en un registro. Anglicismo adaptado, frecuente. Todo piloto es responsable de la registración del auto expedida por Departamento de Transportación y Obras Públicas (Club de corredores del circuito de )
1.en_consolidated_definition: Registration, enrollment. Certificate or act of including a person, vehicle, brand, etc. in a register. Adapted Anglicism, frequent. Every pilot is responsible for the registration of the car issued by the Department of Transportation and Public Works (Racing Club of the Circuit).
